about: OpenCV's sample clip vtest.avi (opencv/samples/data): a busy plaza seen from above, 768x576 at 10 frames a second, 79.5 s. Not a society camera; the same scene the Plaza demo camera plays.
labelled_by: us (the Pehra team), by eye from frames of the clip, on 26 Oct 2026. One labeller, no second check. Times are to about half a second.
rules: enter: a person's feet come into the left walkway zone from outside it (across its right edge, or walking in from the left edge of the picture; nobody crossed its top edge, the taped kerb). cross_in and cross_out: a person's feet cross the walkway edge line (x = 0.5, from y = 0.3 down to the bottom of the picture) going left, onto the walkway side (in), or right (out), and stay across it for at least a second. Someone standing on the edge with their feet across it does not count. People already on the walkway when the clip starts are not entries.
